d:
"Some have been abandoned on the streets, others have battled illness or painful injuries, and many have known nothing but rejection. Now, their stories are about to take a different turn! At Villalobos Rescue Center, Tia Torres takes on some difficult pit bull rescue cases, giving these overlooked dogs the care and attention they've been waiting for.
Watch Pit Bulls & Parolees, Season 8, Episodes 8, 4, 9, 3, 6 and 2, on Animal Planet India."
